title: Open components of an algebra spectrum with specified split reduction
statement: Let A and R be commutative rings, R an A-algebra, and D_j A-algebras indexed by Fin(r). Suppose Spec(D_j) to Spec(A) are universal homeomorphisms [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism], and R modulo its nilradical is isomorphic as an A-algebra to the product of D_j. Then Spec(R) [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is covered by r pairwise disjoint opens W_j whose maps to Spec(A) are universal homeomorphisms. The index set may be empty.

source.place: Proof, finite-algebra calculation: after the reduced tensor algebra is split, take factor spectra and lift their open-and-closed components through reduction.

proof.text: Construct the partition and compatible factor thickenings without hypotheses on the structural maps.

For each factor, cancel its surjective closed immersion using integrality invariance under thickening, surjectivity of the composite, and universal injectivity after arbitrary base change. This is the proved local helper universalHomeomorphism_of_thickening.

proof_origin.place: Factor thickenings followed by cancellation of universal homeomorphisms across source thickening.

lean.statement:
theorem spectrum_components_of_split_reduction
    (A R : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing R] [Algebra A R]
    (r : ℕ) (D : Fin r → Type u) [∀ j, CommRing (D j)] [∀ j, Algebra A (D j)]
    (hD : ∀ j, IsUniversalHomeomorphism
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (D j)))))
    (he : Nonempty ((R ⧸ _root_.nilradical R) ≃ₐ[A] (∀ j, D j))) :
    ∃ (W : Fin r → (Spec (.of R)).Opens),
      (⨆ i, W i) = ⊤ ∧ Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (W i) (W j)) ∧
      ∀ i, IsUniversalHomeomorphism
        ((W i).ι ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A R)))
